_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'pumice_wastes' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

hearth_elder_halla.name: Hearth-elder Halla Morrakk
hearth_elder_halla.greeting: Lastwell has the last good water before the grey. Drink. Then help.

haro_draskar.name: Haro Draskar
haro_draskar.greeting: Stockade's strong. Walls are thick. The raiders are just very, very patient.

matu_tukkari.name: Matu Tukkari
matu_tukkari.greeting: Water is free. Beer costs. Ash in your beer is free as well.

angler_lastwell.name: Kirra Askaru
angler_lastwell.greeting: The sea is the only thing out here that is not on fire. I like the sea. The nearest pool is about 790 paces west of here. Look for the ripples.

carter_lastwell.name: Matu Imbaru
carter_lastwell.greeting: Walking is free. Riding is nearly free, and you arrive with your feet unboiled.

quests.name: The Raider Trails
quests.offer: Slagborn run the trails across the Wastes like they own them. Every water cart that leaves Lastwell comes back as a story. Go and change the ending.

steps.text: Kill 8 Slagborn raiders on the trails

quests.done: A cart came back with water in it. Water! We had a small party.

quests.name: A Golem on the Pipe
quests.offer: The pumice golems wander in off the grey dunes and sit down on our well-pipe. Then they do not get up. A golem is very heavy and a pipe is not.

steps.text: Kill 5 pumice golems on the grey dunes

quests.done: The tap runs! I will put that in my beer, sparingly.

quests.name: The Ash Reaver
quests.offer: Out at the burned-out farm the raiders have a reaver who comes out of the ash storms with a hook on a chain. The Ash Reaver. We lose a watchman every storm. I am running out of watchmen.

steps.text: Kill 5 Slagborn raiders near the burned-out farm

quests.done: Next storm, nobody gets hooked. I will tell the watchmen. Both of them.

quests.name: The Tally Man
quests.offer: Out on the ash pans walks a tall grey thing with a stick full of notches. One notch for every traveller it has met. We have counted them. The stick is long. Make him stop counting.

steps.where: the ash pans of the Pumice Wastes

quests.done: Bring me the stick. I want to know if my cousin is on it.

quests.name: The Dry Wells
quests.offer: Lastwell is the last well because the others ran dry and something moved into them. The old wells go down into lava tubes, deep and warm. Take a party and take our water back.

steps.text: Climb down into the Dry Wells
steps.where: The Dry Wells, the dungeon door in the Pumice Wastes

steps.text: Defeat what drank the wells dry
steps.where: the bottom of The Dry Wells

quests.done: If there is water down there, we will find it. If not, at least nothing is coming up. The Rim-keepers on the Caldera could use you too, when you are ready for the climb.

quests.name: Warlord Thrane
quests.offer: Thrane Cinderhand calls himself warlord of the Wastes. When the drums start out in the grey, he is coming for the stockade. When you hear them, get to the wall.

steps.where: the grey outside Lastwell Stockade, when the drums start (zone event)
steps.text: Defeat Warlord Thrane when he attacks

quests.done: His drum is our drum now. It is very loud. The kiln folk up on the ridge have their own raiders, if you liked this.
